name: Rack focus
source: Freefield (neuregex/freefield, MIT), adapted to Moonfactory's Wan 2.2 worker
description: Focus pulls from foreground to background. The camera does not move.

prompt.fragment: racks focus from the foreground to the background
prompt.compose: The camera {fragment}. prepended to the scene prompt; up to 3 moves joined with ', then ' in picked order (see composition grammar in presets-index.json).

fidelity: approximate: prompt-guided camera work on Wan 2.2, not a baked-in camera control. Freefield's lab note applies here too: one move holds best; with two or more the model does not always keep the order.
